messages:
Aisha Khan: Noticed the API reference for POST /v1/annotate has inconsistent request examples. One page shows "items": {"text": "..."} while the server expects an array of strings. I opened a small docs PR to correct the YAML and the snippets: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4601
Leo Martin: Thanks. Do we also need a migration note for SDKs that auto-coerced single string -> array?
Aisha Khan: Yes, add short note: older SDKs (<0.4.1) accepted a string; new SDKs require an array or null. Suggest sample helper: if (typeof v === 'string') v = [v];
Priya Rao: Can you paste the preferred curl + python snippet? I'll add them to the site build.
Leo Martin: Quick examples:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/annotate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"items":["text1","text2"]}'

# python
resp = client.post('/v1/annotate', json={"items":["text1","text2"]})
print(resp.json())

Aisha Khan: Also update the OpenAPI schema to items: {type: array, items: {type: string}, nullable: true} and add a short callout: null => streaming input.
docs-bot: PR 4601 created and passed basic lint checks: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4601 :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: I'll review and run the local build after Ben merges the YAML change.
